Description: The nacelle structure shall withstand ultimate loads (1.5× limit loads) without structural failure for a minimum of 3 seconds.
Acceptance_Criteria: No structural failure at 1.5× LL for ≥3 seconds

Description: The pylon shall maintain structural integrity under all flight and ground load conditions including engine-out and fan blade-out scenarios.
Acceptance_Criteria: Positive margin of safety under all design load cases

Description: The nacelle-to-pylon attachment shall be designed to transfer all operational and emergency loads with adequate fatigue life.
Acceptance_Criteria: Fatigue life ≥60000 flight hours; ultimate factor 1.5

Description: The thrust reverser structure shall withstand deployment loads and stowed aerodynamic loads without permanent deformation.
Acceptance_Criteria: No permanent deformation under limit loads

Description: Engine mount interfaces shall accommodate engine thrust and inertial loads while maintaining alignment within specified tolerances.
